purpose: Test whether a broad positive single-relaxation basis of finite-memory responses collapses onto a low-dimensional observable CMB subspace after six-parameter LambdaCDM projection.

physics.memory_class: causal passive positive exponential/Drude relaxation basis

basis.template_definition: centered eta tangent from +lambda and -lambda runs using the accepted CLASS source-grid trace and positive continuum Drude forcing
basis.normalization_for_shape_PCA: each projected template is normalized to unit norm in the pre-data TT/TE/EE cosmic-variance metric before SVD
basis.amplitude_information: reported separately and not used to define dimensionality

observable_metric.covariance: full-sky unlensed cosmic-variance metric used only as a pre-data observable-space geometry

nuisance_projection.derivatives: five-point D5 construction when available; otherwise the already-certified v0.49 D5-equivalent basis is to be reused without retuning

predeclared_dominance_metrics.interpretation_rule: If the gate fails, report the failure. Do not change the tau grid, metric, nuisance definition, or normalization after inspecting the result in order to recover dominance.

separation_from_real_data: No Planck, ACT, or SPT likelihood value is used in v0.57. This is a theory-space generality test. The generality campaign was initiated after the first Planck analysis and is therefore not described as pre-Planck, but its v0.57 protocol is frozen before inspecting v0.57 outputs.
next_if_successful: v0.58 positive multi-pole mixtures and random positive spectral measures
v0.59 kernel-family universality and leading-mode stability
